front: When does a tax cut raise revenue?
back: When the rate is above the revenue-maximising rate (the downward-sloping part of the Laffer curve).

front: Name three types of time lag.
back: Recognition lag, decision lag and impact lag.

front: Why is expansionary fiscal policy likely to worsen the current account?
back: Higher incomes raise spending on imports.
